headline: A jury in Malta acquits a businessman in the killing of reporter Daphne Caruana Galizia
context: Investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia had written extensively about suspected corruption in political and business circles in Malta. She was killed by a car bomb in 2017, at age 53.
